The '''Redcap system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim's]] [[Savareen sector/Legends|Savareen sector]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Redcap]].
